# --diff mutates only what changed since a git revision. The unit is a
# template rendered with one type of dot, which is what a run mutates
# once, so a template is mutated when its text changed or when it is now
# reached with a type of dot it was not reached with at the revision.
#
# Here "page" renders "name" with .Name and "count" with .Count. When Page
# becomes Summary, "page" is reached with a new type, and so is "count",
# whose .Count went from int to float64. "name" still gets a string and
# still reads the same, so there is nothing new to learn from it.

git init -q
git add go.mod
git commit -q -m empty
git tag empty
git add .
git commit -q -m base

cp template.go.next template.go
muxt test-template-mutations -v --dry-run --seed 1 --diff HEAD
cmp stdout want-types.txt
! stderr .

# A template whose text changed is mutated even though its dot did not.

git commit -q -am types
cp templates.gohtml.next templates.gohtml
muxt test-template-mutations -v --dry-run --seed 1 --diff HEAD
cmp stdout want-text.txt
! stderr .

# A revision the templates cannot be read at, such as one from before the
# package existed, leaves nothing to compare with, so everything counts as
# changed and the report says why.

muxt test-template-mutations --dry-run --seed 1 --diff empty
stdout '^4 mutants across 3 templates'
stdout '^every template counts as changed: the templates at empty could not be read'

# A revision git does not know is an error.

! muxt test-template-mutations --dry-run --diff no-such-revision
stderr 'no-such-revision'

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "page"}}{{template "name" .Name}}{{template "count" .Count}}{{end}}
{{define "name"}}<b>{{.}}</b>{{end}}
{{define "count"}}<i>{{.}}</i>{{end}}
-- templates.gohtml.next --
{{define "page"}}{{template "name" .Name}}{{template "count" .Count}}{{end}}
{{define "name"}}<b>{{.}}</b>!{{end}}
{{define "count"}}<i>{{.}}</i>{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name  string
	Count int
}

func Render(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", page)
}
-- template.go.next --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Summary struct {
	Name  string
	Count float64
}

func Render(w io.Writer, summary Summary) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "page", summary)
}
